'''''Zinn's Revenge''''' was a modified [[CorelliSpace]] [[Gymsnor-3 light freighter/Legends|Gymsnor-3 light freighter]].

==Description==
The ''Zinn's Revenge'' was a [[CorelliSpace]] [[Gymsnor-3 light freighter/Legends|Gymsnor-3 light freighter]]. Measuring 34.1 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] from bow to stern,<ref name="Sins-CC" /> the heavily-modified [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]<ref name="Sins-GK" /> was armed with four heavy [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]], each mounted on a separate arc<ref name="Sins-CC" /> and capable of being fired separately.<ref name="Sins-GK" /> The ''Zinn's Revenge'' was also equipped with a full [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] suite, [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], and a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]]. A Class One [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] allowed the ship to travel through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]], while a slower Class Ten unit was installed aboard as a backup in case of emergency. The ship was capable of reaching speeds up to 800 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] in [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. ''Zinn's Revenge'' was designed to be operated by two crew with four [[Gunner/Legends|gunners]] handling the weapons, although the ship could be flown by a single individual if needed. Six passengers could travel aboard, and the vessel was capable of carrying 10 [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]] of cargo,<ref name="Sins-CC" /> within a space of ten [[Cubic meter/Legends|cubic meters]].<ref name="Sins-GK" /> Consumables to last a [[Standard month/Legends|month]] were stored on board.<ref name="Sins-CC" />

==History==
The ''Zinn's Revenge'' was owned by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Zinn Classet]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], he led a group of hunters including fellow Human [[Andar Sizzton]], [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Uthil Ren'kacal]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Jargool Muus]], and the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Negollup]].<ref name="Sins-GK" /> Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="Dating">[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Heggel]]'s entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' states that he took command of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces in the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] shortly after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Not long after this, the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]] is constructed, a process that only takes fourteen [[Standard day/Legends|days]].</ref> the group was contracted by representatives of the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]] to hunt down a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives<ref name="Sins-GK" /> who had freed one of their [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Kentara]].<ref name="Enslaved">{{WEGCite|story=Rebel Enslaved!|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Kit}}</ref>
